text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: watcherbot alert fired for inference-gateway-eu-west1 - 5xx rate spike (502/504). trigger: error_rate > 5% (1m). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/inference/alerts/823 | Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx

pagerduty: Incident INC-87431 created and paged: sre-oncall. escalation policy: 10m -> ops-lead if unacked.

sre-oncall: acked. I'm taking this. pulling up recent traces and traffic-slice. will check kv-cache first.

ops-leo: seeing large number of kvproxy evictions + connection resets to model-backend. sample logs: `kvcache: evict key=ctx:abcd... reason=oom` - also a flurry of `upstream reset` in proxy-01.

eng-jess: confirmed, kvcache eviction + redis errors around same time. could be mem pressure during autoscale. rolling proxy-01 to force reconnect and warm caches. will also enable shorter keepalive for edge.

ops-leo: running quick restart on proxy-01: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-proxy -n infra-eu --selector=zone=eu-west1`
```
ops-leo: restart started on kv-proxy/kv-proxy-01 (pod/kv-proxy-01 -> terminating)
```

pm-maria: any customer-facing impact yet? any slowdowns on hosted API? need ETA to update comms.

eng-jess: looking at request-level counts — affected routes are `/v1/inference` and `/v1/chat/stream`. error spike correlates with a batch job hitting a large prompt. soft-failover to model-variant `small-latency` recommended while we stabilize.

infra-kate: enabling fallback routing to small-latency model for eu-west1 now (policy id: fb-eu-202). patch applied.

incidentbot: update: fallback routing enabled, kv-proxy restart in progress. will monitor error rate.

ops-leo: logs after restart: `proxy-01 connected to backend`, eviction rate dropped.

sre-oncall: monitoring metrics — error_rate dropped from 6.8% -> 0.9% in the last 2m. latency stable. marking this as mitigated for now.

pm-maria: thanks. I'll hold off on customer comms until we see stable for 15m. keeping status page draft ready.

eng-jess: follow-up action: add guardrails to batch job (rate-limit, prefix caching) and add alert to detect mem pressure on kv nodes. I'll open a PR.

infra-kate: filing infra ticket for kvcache autosize and probe improvements.

pagerduty: Incident INC-87431 status changed to "acknowledged" -> "resolved" by sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: resolved. leaving notes in runbook and will hand off to daily oncall for postmortem. :thumbsup:
